div.p: A child element of agent, function, place and subject used to specify the type of relation that these entities have with the entity being described within the EAS instance.

Use relationship within agent, function, place and subject to specify the type of relation that these entities have with the entity being described within the EAS instance. The relationship element contains a textual description of the relation. It is recommended that values used in relationship be taken from an authorized vocabulary.

Use valueURI to provide a number, code, or string (e.g., URI) that uniquely identifies the genre or form in a controlled vocabulary, taxonomy, ontology, or other knowledge organization system. Use vocabularySource and/or vocabularySourceURI to name and/or point to the organization system used.
Use role in agent, function, place and subject to more specifically indicate the role of the related entity towards the entity being described in the EAS instance.
